# Guideline for Plotly Dash

## Callbacks

### General

Pass around references to components instead of using string constants
(component ids).

Ex:
```
my_button = button(...)
@callback(
    Input(my_button, 'n_clicks')
)
```

### Inputs

Try to only have one input per callback, unless you don't need to distinguish
between them. This should enable you to avoid using dash.ctx. if you need it
then it's a sign of bad design.

### Outputs

Prefer having multiple callbacks with the same outputs over one big callback
with a context switch. Use `Output(allow_multiple=True)` to enable multiple
callbacks with the same output. This also requires setting
`@callback(prevent_initial_callback=True)`, except for callbacks directly on the
app (`@app.callback`) which inherit the app config:

```
app = Dash(prevent_initial_callbacks=True)
```

### Stores

Separate callbacks from/to different components with stores. ex: instead of
directly connecting two components with a callback, you would write to a store
associated with the target component, and have an additional callback for
reacting to the store and mutating the target component.
